create.name: Dr. Shamini Jain
create.bio:
Dr. Shamini Jain is an American clinical psychologist, researcher and teacher whose work brings together scientific research and spiritual practice. She studied neuroscience at Columbia University, earned her doctorate in clinical psychology through the joint programme of the University of California, San Diego and San Diego State University, and completed postdoctoral training at UCLA. She is an adjunct professor in family medicine at UC San Diego and founded the Consciousness and Healing Initiative, a non-profit that brings scientists, practitioners, educators and artists together to study the biofield and the practice of healing.

Alongside her research she trained in energy work with Rev. Rosalyn Bruyere and draws on the Jain, Vedic and Tantric traditions. Her teaching combines short summaries of the research with guided meditation, mantra, chanting and voice work, and she often uses sound and song, having released an album, Kaliyuga Blues. Sounds True published her book on the biofield, Healing Ourselves: Biofield Science and the Future of Health. She has taught at Esalen, the Omega Institute and the Sivananda Ashram in the Bahamas, and teaches self-paced courses online through The Shift Network.

books.title: Healing Ourselves: Biofield Science and the Future of Health
books.author: Shamini Jain
books.description: An introduction to biofield science, the study of the subtle energy fields around and within living things, written by a clinical psychologist and researcher. It looks at what research on mind-body practices, placebo and energy work suggests, and sets this beside traditional spiritual teachings. Each chapter includes simple practices for readers to try.

courses.title: Sacred Sound and Energy Healing Retreat
courses.description: A weekend retreat at the Sivananda Ashram on Paradise Island in the Bahamas. It combines an overview of research on the biofield and mind-body practice with mantra and voice work, chakra meditations, creative expression and ritual. Accommodation is booked separately from tuition.

courses.title: The Graces of Power
courses.description: A yoga vacation programme at the Sivananda Ashram in the Bahamas, exploring power as life force and the divine feminine in the Vedic and Tantric traditions. It is taught through four satsangs and three workshops using energy, movement and sound practices, and is open to everyone.

Both of her current Shift Network courses were left out under the strict health-claim rule (see left_out); a human may want to list them with neutral descriptions, since their titles are clean.

The Science of Healing Course (CHI, $497 USD) was left out as borderline: it is a clinically framed continuing-education course for mental health and nursing providers, and the live sessions on its page are dated 2024.
Her YouTube channel mixes teaching with music videos (Rock Goddess Collective, cover songs); only teaching videos were chosen, and the masterclass is co-led with Bruce Lipton.
The Graces of Power price depends on Sivananda room rates, so it is given as 'Contact for pricing'.

1:1 consultation: not her main way of working.
Free 'Grounding with Sound' meditation: only offered via newsletter sign-up on her home page, no own URL. CHI webinar replays need a paid contributor membership.

YouTube: music videos, short clips under 2 minutes (Amplify your Healing Wisdom, What is a Mantra?, MAYA), interview clips where the guest is the main speaker (Bruce Lipton, Gregg Braden, Cyndi Dale, Dawson Church, Eileen McKusick, Maya Shetreat), and 'Good Day LA - Breathing Impact on Mental Health' (mental-health framing, borderline).
